messages:
Alex: quick twilight check-in — did KV eviction rollout canary (20%) earlier today. Noticed 95p embed latency bumped ~25% (310ms) on eu-west. Blocker: can't reproduce locally, metrics only. Today: rolling canary back to 10%, opening follow-up ticket and attaching traces. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1287

Maya: saw the same spike on dashboards around 09:12 UTC, adding trace ids to the run. Can you post the canary link? I’ll queue a debug job and grep logs. :mag:

Jonah: +1 on rollback if 95p is drifting. If you need a quick mitigation we can force the batcher size down for that route; worked last time. Config snippet to try: `batcher.max_batch_size=4`.

Alex: rolled canary back to 10% at 1748882600 and toggled `kv_warmup=true` temporarily. Log excerpt: ```evict: completed 1200 keys; 95p latency 312ms -> 205ms after rollback``` — saving full logs in the ticket.

Li: oncall follow-up — I’ll own the postmortem starter. Alex, paste traces + exact host ids in the ticket. Also there’s a pending CR maya/kv-evict-fix that needs a reviewer. @Devon can you take a look? Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1290

Devon: on it, I’ll review in the next 30m. FYI CI is flaky on `test_batcher` for me, increasing timeout helped locally so I’ll include a note. :computer:

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-482 — severity: P2. PagerDuty notified the oncall rotation. :bell:

Maya: small follow-up — can we add an alerting rule to catch 95p increases >25% above baseline sustained for 10m? That would catch regressions earlier. I can draft the rule (prometheus/alertmanager).

Jonah: +1 to that alert. Will draft alert syntax and a runbook step for quick rollback and batcher throttle.

Alex: thanks all — leaving notes in PR and ticket. I’ll also add the canary dashboards link to the incident. TKT-334 created for post-rollout cleanups. :thumbsup:
